summary: @or-sdk/qna preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's `preinstall` hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip` for the installer's platform, extracts it, chmods it 0755, and invokes it via `execFileSync` against a bundled ~727 KB sibling file `math_init.js`. The advertised purpose is a Q&A SDK, which does not require a second language runtime. `setup.mjs` itself uses hex-mangled identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `_0x19328d`, per-function jump-table objects) with no functional need, and `math_init.js` is a single-line `@bun @bun-cjs` bundle with a rotated string-array decoder (`WV8StW` shuffle over `n7gIxM`), making the code executed at install time non-inspectable without runtime decoding. Installing the package auto-executes opaque bundled code on the installer's machine through a freshly-downloaded alien runtime — the classic scanner-evasion alternate-runtime dropper pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
